title: .trishul.yml
description: Trishul project configuration (v2). Place this file at the repo root. Policy that decides blocking (the gate) is always read from the base branch.

profile.description: Named preset of defaults to start from (e.g. default, strict, agent).

max_summary.description: Maximum rows in the summary table (default 25).

gate.description: Blocking policy. Read from the base branch so a PR cannot weaken its own gate.

block_on.description: Severities that fail the gate (default [CRITICAL, HIGH]).

fail_on_new.description: Fail only on findings the PR introduces relative to the base (default true).

rules.description: Per-rule overrides keyed by rule id or glob (e.g. EXPLOIT-AZURE-*). Most specific match wins; exact id beats glob.

ignore.description: Globs (e.g. vendor/**, *.min.js) or bare path segments to skip.

experimental.description: Opt in to experimental rules in full reports (never shown inline).
